name.ja: 1/35 サンドランド国王軍戦車隊104号車
name.en: 1/35 Sandland Royal Army Tank Corps No. 104

categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

ja: 2023年夏公開の映画『SAND LAND』より、1/35スケールの国王軍戦車隊１０４(ヒトマルヨン)号車がプラモデルで商品化！
• 装甲の溶接跡などプラモデルならではの精密な設計により、全高約１１０ｍｍの車体にスケールモデルを意識したディテールが満載。
• 主砲は可動式。砲塔は左右方向に旋回、主砲の上下可動に合わせて内部の装填機構部分も上下に連動。
• 車体の左右、正面に設置されたハッチは開閉式。ハッチから覗く車内の構造も組み立てることができる。
• アンテナ軸パーツは、金属製とプラスチック樹脂製の2種が付属。
• ハッチを開けて設置できる、固定ポーズの同スケールキャラクターフィギュア「ベルゼブブ」「シーフ」「ラオ」が付属。劇中の冒険を彷彿とさせるイメージでディスプレイが可能！
• 隠れた箇所の転輪や履帯内側の形状など戦車の特徴を表現。
• 履帯の走行跡も造形で表現したディスプレイベース、立ち上る砂埃、作品タイトルロゴのプレートも付属。
en: From the movie "SAND LAND" to be released in the summer of 2023, the 1/35 scale Royal Army Tank Corps No. 104 (Hitomaruyon) is commercialized as a plastic model!

• Due to the precise design unique to plastic models, such as the welding marks on the armor, the body is approximately 110mm in height, and is packed with details that are reminiscent of Scale Models.
• The main gun is movable. The turret rotates left and right, and the internal loading mechanism also moves up and down as the main gun moves up and down.
• The hatches installed on the left, right, and front sides of the vehicle can be opened and closed. The interior structure of the car that can be seen through the hatch can also be assembled.
• Two types of antenna shaft parts are included: metal and plastic resin.

• Includes the same scale character figures "Beelzebub", "Thief" and "Rao" in fixed poses that can be installed by opening the hatch. You can display images reminiscent of the adventures in the movie!
• Represents tank characteristics such as hidden wheels and the shape of the inside of the tracks.
• Also included is a display base that depicts the track tracks, rising dust, and a plate with the title logo of the work.
